Manifest.Name: Probably Not Human
Manifest.Author: Tundra
Manifest.Description:
Lets AI agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor play the game through MCP. Runs locally. The agent plays on your real save, so use a spare slot. Requires the companion client: github.com/TundraWork/ProbablyNotHuman
让 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 AI 工具通过 MCP 自己玩游戏。纯本地运行。AI 是在你的真存档上玩的，建议单独留一个存档位。需要安装配套客户端：github.com/TundraWork/ProbablyNotHuman
